about: Mona Shores' two robots, 19429 (Infrared) and 20245 (Ultraviolet), for the match and drill simulator. Data only: src/sim/robots/mona-shores.ts maps it onto upstream's RobotConfig. Every number has a source: a biobuzz file (master), a measured log or film, or 'upstream' where neither team has data. null means not measured yet, so upstream's value stays.

slewDegPerSec.source: not measured; floor is 10-13 deg/s (RobotDifferences 19429, 20 Nov), top rate unlogged

release.source: the feeder sends the lane through the throat in order

betweenBallsS.source: biobuzz timing-terms.md, Belding: about 0.45 s between balls

spinUpWaitS.source: biobuzz timing-terms.md, Belding, launcher already running

gateToFourthBallS.source: biobuzz timing-terms.md, Belding; logs 2.04 s (19429, n=14) / 2.08 s (20245, n=36): drill chat, Visualizer src/drill/presets.ts (PR #150), from events/2026-11-fruitport and -belding: 104 logs 19429, 95 logs 20245

widthIn.source: RobotDesign.real: 0.9 x the 16.2 in frame (the intake between the front wheels)

contactSlackIn.source: FieldSim.INTAKE_CONTACT_SLACK_IN; RobotDesign.real intakeOnContact: a piece is taken only once it touches the intake's face

grabChance.source: PLACEHOLDER, RobotDesign.intakeGrabChance: never measured; toss pieces in and count

intervalS.source: PLACEHOLDER, RobotDesign.intakeIntervalS: 4 pieces in about 1 s (mentor review); never timed

stickReachIn.source: biobuzz cad/advantagescope/Robot_BIOBUZZ (the Onshape CAD): model_1.glb, the FLOWER stick, swung 162 deg out about its axis in components.json: its tip lies on the floor 0.351 m (13.8 in) ahead of the axles' middle, 5.7 in past the 8.1 in half frame. The logs agree: with the stick down the robot stops with its centre about 13 in from the wall (GardenGather notes, 72 gathers).

stickWidthIn.source: biobuzz cad/advantagescope/Robot_BIOBUZZ (the Onshape CAD): model_1.glb, the FLOWER stick, swung 162 deg out about its axis in components.json: the shaft on the floor spans y -0.160 to 0.161 m. Pressed on the side wall it covers 1.8 to 14.4 in from it, so the corner POLLEN (centre 1.4 in out) stays, as the mentor saw (13 Nov 2026)

flowerStick.source: biobuzz RobotDifferences: roller on its end, a CR servo (17 Nov 2026)

topSpeedInPerS.source: fastest Auto legs (read_logs.py legs); drill chat, Visualizer src/drill/presets.ts (PR #150), from events/2026-11-fruitport and -belding: 104 logs 19429, 95 logs 20245

accelInPerS2.source: 98th percentile rise of /Drive/OdometrySpeedInPerSec at full stick below 35 in/s; drill chat, Visualizer src/drill/presets.ts (PR #150), from events/2026-11-fruitport and -belding: 104 logs 19429, 95 logs 20245

turnDegPerS.source: 98th percentile heading rate at full turn; drill chat, Visualizer src/drill/presets.ts (PR #150), from events/2026-11-fruitport and -belding: 104 logs 19429, 95 logs 20245

angleDeg.source: direction of travel in robot axes: forward, diagonal, strafe (back and the other side mirror these)

topInPerS.source: 98th percentile speed, 74 logs; TeleOp in robot axes (Pinpoint pose rotated by heading, stick held at 0.9 or more, no turn), events/2026-11-fruitport and -belding, matches and practice

approachStandoffIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/FlowerPicker.java LineUp.approachStandoffIn: the staging spot, square to the FLOWER, this far from its centre

pushSpeed.source: biobuzz opmodes/FlowerPicker.java Push.pushSpeed (master: drive power; here a fraction of top speed)

backSpeed.source: biobuzz opmodes/FlowerPicker.java Back.backSpeed (fraction of top speed here)

flowerPullS.source: PLACEHOLDER, RobotDesign.flowerPullS: time to drag one POLLEN out of a FLOWER; never timed per robot (19429 roller, 20245 passive)

maxRangeIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/FlowerPicker.java LineUp.maxRangeIn: only a FLOWER whose centre is this close to the robot is picked, else refused ("no FLOWER within 60 in")

gatherPose.source: biobuzz localization/GardenFieldPoints.RED.gather (Pedro x, y in, heading deg); blue is it turned

lineUpOutIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java LineUp.lineUpOutIn: negative presses the robot onto the side wall

inSpeed.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java DriveIn.inSpeed (fraction of top speed here)

stickStopIn.source: 8.1 in half frame + the stick's 5.7 in reach (CAD); the logs' 'about 13 in' (GardenGather notes, 72 gathers) agrees to within an inch

backSpeed.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Back.backSpeed (fraction of top speed here)

anyCorner.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Button.anyCorner: the TeleOp button gathers in the nearest of all four field corners (localization/GardenFieldPoints.nearestCorner), facing whichever of its two walls is nearer the heading; an Auto card never does

maxRangeIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java DriveIn.maxRangeIn: only a corner whose gather pose is this close is gathered from

followWallLine.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java LineUp.followWallLine: with lineUpOutIn into the wall, the drive in runs along the line the line-up stopped on

stallWithinIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java LineUp.stallWithinIn: a line-up pressed onto the wall ends once it stalls this close to its pose

lowerMaxTurnDegPerSec.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Stick.lowerMaxTurnDegPerSec: the stick comes down only while turning slower than this

retractAfterBackIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Stick.retractAfterBackIn: a gather stopped before its drive back lifts the stick this far from the gather pose

settledInPerSec.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java DriveIn.settledInPerSec: the drive in starts once the robot is slower than this

laneTowardWallIn.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java DriveIn.laneTowardWallIn (the curve to the wall)

intoCornerDeg.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java DriveIn.intoCornerDeg: the drive in, push and dwell turn the intake this far toward the wall run along

dwellPushPower.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Dwell.dwellPushPower: forward power during the dwell

headingKp.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Steering.headingKp: turn power per radian, while dwelling

lateralKp.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Steering.lateralKp: strafe power per inch off the line, while dwelling

backStallMs.source: biobuzz opmodes/GardenGather.java Back.backStallMs: the back out ends where it is after this long without getting closer

settleMaxMs.source: biobuzz opmodes/GrabRoutine.java SETTLE_MAX_MS: the longest a grab waits to face the line-up heading, and to slow before the drive in
